research_notes: The experiment should not convert a target-class pass into a claim that the system cannot run longer.
It only establishes a lower-bound survival observation at that class.
Likewise a candidate failure boundary is not a deterministic universal timeout until replicated/refined.
This language matters because runtime behavior can be variable.
The final user-facing result should distinguish observed lower bound, failure region, and promoted operating cap.
